proposed.enrollment: Open enrollment using one shared four-digit leadership PIN and an approved self-asserted name picker.
proposed.namePickerSource: Main-provided approved display-name list only. No guessed contact email or inferred identity.
proposed.attribution: Shared PIN and self-selected name do not authenticate an individual person. Audit labels must identify the asserted name and independent persistent browser/device credential; do not claim verified personal identity.
proposed.persistence: Opaque per-browser credential stays server-validated and revocable.
proposed.rotation: Later manually initiated PIN rotation may stop new enrollment without revoking existing browser credentials; exact backend contract required. No automatic schedule or rotation added.
proposed.roles: Employee roles and separate Map system remain unchanged. Backend controls edit permissions and attempt limits.

frontendStatus: No PIN form, credential endpoint, secret, role change or activation implemented. Await Main explicit backend API contract.
existingViewer: Link viewer already has no enrollment dependency in current Source; backend public aggregate and public-event response restrictions must remain.
